must.text: Diff confinement. Caller hunks touch only drain() (629caa23 100-115), optionally plus one module-level tolerance constant and extra fields in the caller_drains record. Test hunks only add F1 regression tests and change the qualification test output root. Any other behavior-changing hunk is OUT_OF_SCOPE and blocks until the Mayor separately scopes it.

The guard content of 629caa23 107-110 is retained unchanged and still evaluated on every reading before the idle predicate: all three DRAIN_FIELDS plus tokenizer_fallback_requests are int or float, finite and >= 0, and tokenizer_fallback_requests == 0, else refusal.
current_in_flight == 0 and current_waiting == 0 remain exact comparisons; no tolerance or rounding is applied to either counter or to the fallback counter.

The idle cost test is exactly current_admitted_cost <= 1e-9 (inclusive) on the observed value. 1e-9 is a source literal or module constant and is not read from the environment, argv, protocol, permit or any server response. For finite x >= 0 this equals the gateway's own math.isclose(x, 0.0, rel_tol=1e-12, abs_tol=1e-9).

No other relaxation. Each reading is a fresh /metrics observation through the unchanged observe(); remaining(), the original deadline and reserve, sleep(min(0.05, remaining)) and the NOT_RUN or FAILED handling when idle is never reached are unchanged; raw per-reading evidence persistence (observe 93-97) is unchanged.

Committed, self-contained regression tests (no .runtime fixture imports) drive drain() through the unchanged observe() path with served /metrics bodies: (a) zero counters, fallback 0 and cost 2.7755575615628914e-17 drain with readings == 1; (b) cost 1e-6 with zero counters does not drain and ends in the original-deadline refusal; (c) current_in_flight 1 with cost 0 does not drain; (d) current_waiting 1 with cost 0 does not drain.
Sensitivity. Case R6(a) is shown red on 629caa23, either by a preserved author control or by own W2. A regression test that would also pass on 629caa23 does not satisfy R6(a).
Smoke 585e606f and smoke test 158c4e32 stay byte-unchanged, so the smoke test ROOT.mkdir() no-clobber behavior is retained.

For the same NATIVE_SMOKE_TEST_OUTPUT value, the qualification test output root is not equal to, an ancestor of or a descendant of the smoke ROOT, and creating it never creates the smoke ROOT path; therefore both import or collection orders succeed in a fresh parent directory.
Recorded drain evidence stays strict-JSON safe: any recorded residual is the observed finite float and any recorded tolerance is 1e-9.
